neutral_outfits.strategy: Almost all cheek families work; tune intensity to the occasion.

warm_earth_outfits.strategy: Warm cheeks create tonal harmony; berry/mauve can provide contrast.

green_emerald_outfits.strategy: Peach/clay is a warm contrast; rose/berry creates richer contrast.

blue_navy_teal_outfits.strategy: Rose/mauve gives cool coordination; coral/peach gives warm contrast.

pink_red_burgundy_outfits.strategy: Choose related rose/berry tones or a softer petal tone to balance the outfit.

cross_category_lip_coordination.rule: Default to related color families for a coordinated look; allow complementary contrast when the user requests a bolder look.

depth_application_rules.fair_light: Start with a light hand; build gradually, especially with berry/clay shades.
depth_application_rules.light_medium_medium: Medium application intensity is the default.
depth_application_rules.medium_tan_tan: Favor medium-to-rich application so colour remains visible.
depth_application_rules.deep_very_deep: Prefer richer application and more saturated/deeper families when the user wants clearly visible colour; lighter shades remain eligible for soft/brightening effects.

guardrails: Complexion depth and undertone are ranking signals, not hard eligibility gates.
Do not describe mock HEX as brand-confirmed or spectrophotometer-measured.
Do not claim long wear, transfer proof, skin-care efficacy, non-comedogenicity, hypoallergenicity, or regulatory approval without verified evidence.
For multi-use products, lip use must stay blocked until final lip-area colourant/formula review is verified in production.

products.name: Airbloom Blush

description.short: A buildable blush designed to add fresh cheek colour.
description.full: Airbloom Blush is a buildable blush designed to add fresh cheek colour. It is positioned to add cheek colour. It also supports fresh or sculpted cheek looks. Final performance claims should be aligned with the validated production formula and testing.
